chunks: He is God in the heavens and the earth. He knows what you hide and bring out into the open, and knows what you earn (of good and evil).
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is in the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am is often cited to affirm God's absolute knowledge (Ilm) encompassing both the manifest and the hidden, reinforcing the concept of divine omnipresence without implying physical location. It serves as a theological foundation for the idea that human deeds, whether secret or public, are fully accounted for by the All-Knowing, a theme frequently linked to the attributes of the Ahl al-Bayt as inheritors of divine knowledge.
